bio: Multidisciplinary graphic designer and art director based in Porto, Portugal, with a degree in Communication Design from the Faculty of Fine Arts of the University of Porto (FBAUP). Since 2015 I have worked on a wide range of projects, from print to digital, with particular expertise in print and graphic production — paper and material selection, printing methods and finishing techniques — and a growing focus on sustainable choices. My core experience lies in branding and packaging, but my work also spans art direction, editorial design, infographics, beverage labelling, naming, environmental design, signage, exhibition design, motion graphics, and web and UI design. More recently, photography has become a natural extension of my design and visual identity work, and most of the projects shown here feature photographs I have taken. I am always looking to sharpen my skills and learn from the world around me, to build more solid ideas and stronger concepts.
